items.title: Regional rail strike called off after late-night deal
items.paragraph: Unions and the operator agreed on a two-year pay settlement just before midnight; trains run normally from the first service.

items.title: Night bus routes extended through the winter
items.paragraph: Three late routes keep running until March, with a new stop by the ferry terminal.

items.title: Library adds a Saturday repair café
items.paragraph: Volunteers fix lamps, bikes and clothes for free every Saturday morning.
